issue_context.title: Test failure: no exception in ResultsOfTResult1TResult2_Throws_InvalidOperationException_WhenResultIsNull
issue_context.body:
While looking at https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/57303 I discovered the `ResultsOfTResult1TResult2_Throws_InvalidOperationException_WhenResultIsNull` and other related tests from src/Http/Http.Results/test/ResultsOfTTests.Generated.cs don't actually throw an InvalidOperationException, but no exception at all.

We didn't notice because we didn't await the Assert.ThrowsAsync.

Filing this issue for tracking.

review_comments: Am I reading correctly that the test was looking for an argument null exception but the argument wasn't null?
Yes, although it throws an `InvalidOperationException` because the null value here is not an argument but the return type of a method we've indicated cannot be null.
I'm kind of surprised there isn't an analyzer for this.

I think there is now, which is why we noticed this.
See https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/57303
Does this sample test need the `(ChecksumResult1)null` change too?

Not necessarily. This one is testing the exception that is thrown when no HTTP context is provided ([ref](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/bc119fc6fd18a68f90a8672959280698ce46577a/src/Http/Http.Results/src/ResultsOfT.Generated.cs#L42)) which happens before we asset on the `IResult` type being null.
